capability.description: Courses, books, and guided audio on sexuality, relationships, and embodied practice. Instant digital delivery, lifetime access, recoverable access link. The full machine-readable catalog with live price and availability is at the catalog API.

productId.description: A product id from the catalog API.

buyerEmail.description: Where the access link is delivered.

price.note: Each product carries priceCents in the catalog API. Range ~$6.99–$997.

payment.note: Catalog products use human card checkout (Clover). Agent-native x402 settlement — USDC on Base, verified ON-CHAIN (receipt-checked, replay-guarded) — is LIVE on this publisher's API. Agent-payable resources are listed at https://api.tantra-authority.com/api/services; GET /api/unlock/<slug> returns an HTTP 402 with a USDC payTo, then present the Base tx hash in X-Payment {network:'base',txHash} to settle.

sla.fulfillment: instant digital delivery by email + recoverable access link

attestations.claim: Published by The Naked Press (DBA of LK Publishing, LLC). Author: Lawrence Lanoff.
Every purchase is backed by a 30-day, no-questions money-back guarantee.
